source: Captured from the real Home Assistant ESPHome add-on (Device Builder 1.25.0, ESPHome 2026.10.1) through its ingress port on 2026-10-31. The add-on is paired with remote build servers, so the compile ran on a receiver; /home/<user>/esphome paths in its output are scrubbed to /remote/esphome. install b2500.yaml --clean: Clean Build, compile (remote), OTA upload to the device.
